name: Parqual Fintallas
summary: In the Undercity's Apothecarium, Parqual Fintallas keeps his love of Lordaeron's history. Though once human, he now lives among the Forsaken and greets travelers with courtesy, sharing his deep knowledge of ancient lore.

sections.title: Scholar of Lost Lordaeron
sections.body: Parqual studied Lordaeron's history as a respected human scholar, surrounded by the kingdom's records. The plague of undeath killed him and raised him among its many victims. Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, he eventually broke free. Many Forsaken embrace cold pragmatism and turn from their former lives. Parqual keeps his scholarly passion and pleasant manners, though the knowledge he seeks has changed since his human life.

sections.title: Keeper of Ancient Lore
sections.body: Parqual lives among the bubbling vats and alchemists of the Undercity's Apothecarium. Its grim surroundings do not lessen his knowledge of Azeroth's history. Travelers facing difficult trials of the mind, including the elusive Test of Lore, are sent to him. He directs them to the Scarlet Monastery's library to find a book, then puts a question of his own to them.

faq.q: Where can I find Parqual Fintallas?
faq.answer: You can find Parqual Fintallas in the Apothecarium beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, in the Forsaken capital of the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Parqual Fintallas known for?
faq.answer: In life, Parqual knew nearly all there was to know about Lordaeron's history. Even in undeath, he remains an authority on history and helps travelers find obscure texts and ancient knowledge.

faq.q: Why is Parqual involved in the Test of Lore?
faq.answer: The Test of Lore asks adventurers to prove their knowledge as well as their strength. Parqual sends them to the Scarlet Monastery for Beginnings of the Undead Threat, then asks a question about the book.

faq.q: Does Parqual share the hostile demeanor of most Forsaken?
faq.answer: Parqual is friendly in everyday conversation and says he is glad when someone takes time to speak with him. Yet he can sharply doubt those who claim to have passed Braug Dimspirit's trials, and he scorns the Scarlet Crusade.

angles.text: As an undead, Parqual recalls Lordaeron's intellectual past through scholarship and civilized conversation, even amid the Apothecarium's bleakness.
As a Horde adventurer facing trials of mind and blade, you can turn to Parqual's deep knowledge of history to uncover Azeroth's ancient truths.
